background.keysCheck: no two states with the same values of these keys have a different background sprite

hitOrder.rule: kit.js:120-125: things with z (in cosas order), then the bird (aveHit), then the frog (frogBox), then the rest in cosas order; each box widened by m (default 3) on every side

hitTest.grid: every 3rd pixel of 240 x 216, in every distinct W

states.grouping: same background sprite(s), the same set things shown with the same boxes, the same values of the set keys

judgments: Characters, for the frames without them: gente, rana, bub2 (functions) and the lines sala.js:115, sala.js:116, sala.js:123, sala.js:124 (config.mjs CHARS).

States are grouped without the character keys cq, gente, ave, lleva, tapaojos, the moving-prop keys vuela and the sign and stamp keys (config.mjs); a thing whose box reads only those keys (movingThings) does not separate states either: its box in every snapshot is in things[id].bySnapshot. The frame of a state shows the characters where the first snapshot of that state had them.

The frames are the scene's draw() only: juego.js's signs (the big hand, the frame around a thing, stars, the heart, answer bubbles) are not drawn; the views add the scene's hud() as the play screen does.
Each frame starts with the canvas default imageSmoothingEnabled = true (the old page keeps whatever the last frame left; order 05 found it on by default).
